verdict.rationale: A public data API is a fair question for a government revenue agency, so the axis applies. The pack shows only web tools and portals (rate lookup, business lookup, My DOR filing), and every OpenAPI/Swagger probe returned 404. Nothing documents published endpoints, a key-issuance path, or stated rate limits.

support.subject: As a developer, the service documents a public API for its data — published endpoints, a key-issuance path, and stated rate limits on its own pages
